## Setup & Read in data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
theme_set(theme_cowplot())
rr <- readRDS("../../../Big_data/Prelim_Scan.RDS")

```

## Make genome scan plot

```{r}
# remove NAs & -log10 p vals
# drop some very high - probably suspect p values
pp <- rr |>
  drop_na()|>
  mutate(logPadj= -log10(Pval_adj)) |>
  filter(CHROM %in% c("2L","2R","3L","3R","X")) |>
  filter(logPadj < 25)

max_vals_chrom <- aggregate(POS ~ CHROM, data = pp, FUN = max)
min_vals_chrom <- aggregate(POS ~ CHROM, data = pp, FUN = min)

scanplot <- pp |>
  ggplot(aes(x = POS,y = logPadj, size = logPadj)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 4/8) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(CHROM)) +
  xlab("Position")+
  ylab("-log10(P-Value Adjusted)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none") +
  scale_size(range = c(0.5, 2)) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = -log10(0.05)), color = 'red4', linetype = 'dotted', alpha = 6/8) +
   geom_hline(aes(yintercept = -log10(0.01)), color = 'red3', linetype = 'dotted', alpha = 5/8) +
   geom_hline(aes(yintercept = -log10(0.001)), color = 'red',
              linetype = 'dotted', alpha = 4/8)


ggsave(scanplot, filename = "../../Plots/Prelim_scan_Evol2025_Poster_SV.jpeg", dpi = 400, width = 12, height = 6)

```
